751-5295-6723.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

7675-7676-8102.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Windswept Heath.
7675-7676-8102.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Windswept Heath.
When Windswept Heath enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Windswept Heath by paying 1 life, tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

678-4192-5659-5753-6495.easyPrerequisites: "Lhurgoyf" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
678-4192-5659-5753-6495.description:
Discard Circling Vultures from your hand using its static ability.
Because Circling Vultures is a Lhurgoyf due to Ashes of the Fallen, Disa the Restless's first ability triggers, putting Circling Vultures from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Circling Vultures.
When Circling Vultures dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Circling Vultures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
678-4192-5659-5753-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

6495-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 3.
6495-6871-6879-6880.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

359-372-1090.manaNeeded: {6}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
359-372-1090.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Restoration Angel until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Acrobatic Maneuver by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Restoration Angel to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Restoration Angel's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Restoration Angel until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Restoration Angel trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

1409-3099-4289-4359.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

2921-3249-5173-5542.description:
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast card from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}
Repeat.

240-997-4875.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-997-4875.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

3197-6719-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6719-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

240-2292-5295-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1
Repeat from step 2.

104-4365-5086-5183-5231.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

3951-4875-5703-7122.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability twice.
Resolve a Altaïr trigger, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the other Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Avatar Kyoshi.

Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.

Repeat from step 3.

2018-5686-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have flying.
2018-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nontoken creature that doesn't have flying.
When the creature dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature with a flying counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Shilgengar abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.

5261-5775-6587-6588.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fortune.
5261-5775-6587-6588.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Fortune's saddle ability by tapping Ultimecia, Omnipotent, causing Fortune to become saddled until end of turn.
Declare Fortune as an attacker. Fortune triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

Activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Key by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Lavabrink Floodgates.
Locus of Enlightenment triggers, copying Voltaic Key's ability, targeting Voltaic Key.
Resolve both Voltaic Key abilities, untapping it and Lavabrink Floodgates.
Repeat.

You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.

Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.

Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.

Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1274-1874-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

When the Servo enters the battlefield, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

575-1207-5413.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability.
Repeat.

1339-2842-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2842-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1978-2364-3488.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Katsumasa.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.

1270-2292-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
1270-2292-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 4.

784-3327-3719-3908.notablePrerequisites:
Dargo and Silas Renn are your commanders.
You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
You control a Treasure token.
784-3327-3719-3908.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R} and sacrificing Spark Double.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Dargo and create seven Treasure tokens.
Choose to put Dargo into the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{B}{R}.
Repeat.

1849-3259-4373.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

Whip Silk enters the battlefield, triggering Historian's Boon's first ability, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature with Whip Silk attached and a Soldier token, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1775-3432.description:
Cast Star of Extinction by paying {5}{R}{R}, destroying target land and dealing 20 damage to each creature and each planeswalker.
Toralf triggers for each creature your opponent control that is dealt excess damage this way.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing damage equal to the excess damage to any target.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.

794-5203.description:
Cast Confiscate by {4}{U}{U}, targeting any permanent on the battlefield.
Holding priority, cast Radiant Performer by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Radiant Performer enters the battlefield, creating a copy of Confiscate for each other permanent on the battlefield.
Resolve each Confiscate, causing you to gain control of all permanents.
